nodes.speaker: Marshal Reyes
nodes.text: Calloway. Word travels: one gala upended, one gold likeness of Cornelius Vane now farming begonias face-first. I assume you're here to explain why.

choices.text: (Hand over the ledger.) Explanation's in his handwriting.

nodes.speaker: Marshal Reyes
nodes.text: ...Forged deeds. Bribery — itemised, the fool. He wrote the sheriff down as 'miscellaneous stern services'. This is the tidiest confession I have ever been handed.

choices.text: Folk just want their farms back.
Page forty's the worst of it.

nodes.speaker: Marshal Reyes
nodes.text: Page for— he charged the TOWN for his own statues. Right. That's quite enough reading.

nodes.speaker: Marshal Reyes
nodes.text: They'll have them. Every deed this book undoes gets undone, starting at sunrise. As for you and your gang, Mr Calloway... let's talk about how this story ends.
